scope: Keep long computer-chat history stable while reading, expose new output without stealing focus, and preserve keyboard access through history controls.
qualification: Local Linux acceptance. Native networking uses an owned local workflow fixture, not real sandbox/Temporal/NSR execution.

failures: The trailing hundred-message window evicted older displayed messages when new output arrived.
Returning to latest removed the focused button without restoring focus.
Loading the last older messages removed its focused button without restoring focus.
Late content resizing did not keep a reader following the latest output at the bottom.
observed_regressions.native_contrast_failure: Unsent draft used #7dd3fc against #eeeff1 in the selected light-theme row, measured 1.44:1; changed only the draft indicator to the existing chat theme-accent token.
observed_regressions.test_setup_correction: First native type check 7ba58d01e610 caught an RTL assertion name used in Playwright. Corrected before native execution.

implementation: Retain the first displayed message identity while away from latest; count older messages from the actual window start and fall back to retained history when an old anchor expires.
Preserve position when prepending history using the captured scroll position and height difference.
Name and focus the transcript scroll region. Restore focus only when an activated history control disappears; keep unrelated composer focus and drafts intact.
Observe content and viewport size changes to follow delayed layout changes only while at latest; release the observer on unmount.
Add a quiet new-message badge and polite status description, deduplicated by message identity across repeated polling.
Keep the draft indicator readable using existing theme tokens. Do not change accessibility rules or visual references.

verification.preflight: Lint, E2E types, Electron and renderer builds passed in the focused native run. Root types and complete coverage passed in the full run.
verification.native_reading_cases: Dark and light: real scroll geometry, keyboard Home/Enter, incoming-message anchor retention, unsent draft and composer focus, unread count, Axe scan, late layout growth, history prepend, and no message signals during reading.

source_guard.method: Manual SHA256 of tracked inputs before and after verification; not an immutable Buildr snapshot.

limitations: Three opt-in live checks require staging configuration. This work does not establish real sandbox, Temporal or NSR acceptance.
Local production startup/restart is verified on Linux; signed macOS/Windows release qualification and updater publication remain pending.
Dependencies and package version are unchanged. Existing advisory findings remain documented in desktop-security-2026-10-15.json.
Changes target the existing review branch; v1.1.19 remains unchanged. No merge or release publication.
